description: This file contains Makefile definitions and variable assignments used for building boot images, device configurations, and image creation procedures for embedded Linux devices based on the i.MX8M platform.

methods.name: Build/boot-scr
methods.description: Creates a U-Boot boot script image using mkimage command.

methods.name: Build/boot-img-ext4
methods.description: Prepares an ext4 boot image directory, copies device tree blobs, kernel, and boot script, then creates a filesystem image.

methods.name: Build/sdcard-img-ext4
methods.description: Generates an SD card image with ext4 filesystem, partition signature, offset, and padding.

methods.name: Device/Default
methods.description: Defines default device parameters such as profiles, filesystems, device tree source directory, kernel install flag, kernel name, and kernel type.

methods.name: Device/imx8m
methods.description: Defines device-specific parameters for the NXP i.MX8M platform, including vendor, model, and device tree source files.

methods.name: Device/gateworks_venice
methods.description: Defines parameters for the Gateworks Venice device, including vendor details, supported device IDs, device tree sources, additional packages, and image build instructions.
